# Sumba Hills

> Sandalwoods, a beachfront resort by Lawang on the south coast of Sumba, Indonesia. Villas from €69,000 and plots from €29,900, one hour's flight from Bali. The site presents the masterplan, the three villa designs and the ownership routes, and collects enquiries by email.

## Key facts
- Developer: Lawang (see https://lawangproperties.com), with Sandalwoods as the resort brand on the island
- Location: south coast of Sumba, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. One hour's flight from Bali or Darwin, one hour by road from the island's main airport
- Masterplan: more than 90 plots across five zones — Beach Club, Lower Zone (Bungalow), Middle Zone (Dune villa), Upper Zone (Dream villa) and Free Zone (plots)
- Villa designs and prices: Bungalow, 1 bedroom, €69,000 with land included · Dune, 1 bedroom, from €69,000 without land · Dream, 2 bedrooms, building area 76 m² and pool terrace 45 m², from €89,000 without land
- Plots: from 210 m², from €29,900
- Payments: €5,000 reservation deposit, land over three months, villa in four instalments of 25% released against construction milestones
- Ownership routes: right of use (Hak Sewa) up to 90 years for a foreign individual · building-use right (HGB) up to 80 years through an Indonesian company (PT PMA) · ownership title (SHM) for an Indonesian national
- Status: first pilot bungalow completed, Phase 1 underway. Villa images on the site are architectural renders
- Contact: sumbahills@lawangproperties.com · +62 811-3820-0932 · https://www.instagram.com/sumbahills/
- Enquiries and brochure: https://sumbahills.lawangproperties.com/#contact
